notes: Market restyled after the Cyberpunk 2077 inventory/vendor screen: red-on-black HUD with crosshair grid, red header rule, cyan active states, yellow CR balance, condensed Rajdhani display type.

Item cards get a rarity stripe and Mk badge colour from the item's dnd5e rarity (common grey, uncommon green, rare blue, very rare purple, legendary orange), a cut corner and a cyan hover state; denser 4-up grid with a short art strip.
Storefront directory, filters, pagination and buttons share the same skin. BUY is solid red, DETAILS is a cyan outline.
New market-cp.css is loaded by ADK_DEV_LOADER as its own style sheet and outranks the older Market theme layers; Market Stock Patch 1.6.1 tags cards with data-feha-rarity.
Styling only: no prices, stock, balances, buttons, filters or Market behavior changed. Text colours pass WCAG AA contrast.
